name: adversarial
description: Adversarial review of a design, plan, spec or code: up to 6 read-only lenses calibrated to the content run via Workflow, an independent skeptic tries to refute every critical/high defect, and fixes are applied only after confirmation, or automatically with --fix. A second command, cross-model-review, adds models from other families (OpenAI via Codex CLI, Google via Antigravity CLI) that you authorize, and sends content to those providers.
